name: Clay
description: GTM data-enrichment workbook platform (150+ data providers) accessed programmatically via inbound table webhooks, an OAuth MCP server, and an Enterprise-only people/company lookup API.
access_notes: Clay accounts are self-serve with a free tier; inbound table webhooks work on free plans and the MCP server (with Functions/permissioning) is available on self-serve Launch/Growth plans, with company/contact lookups even for free and trial users. However the general People & Company HTTP lookup API is Enterprise-plan-only, and HTTP API enrichment columns require Growth ($495/mo) or above.
mcp_notes: Official vendor MCP server at https://api.clay.com/v3/mcp with OAuth 2.0 + open Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591, no Clay-side approval); exposed in ChatGPT/Claude/Codex. No Clay toolkit found in the docs.composio.dev/toolkits catalog.
uncertainty_notes: Clay is workflow-first, not API-first: no public versioned REST API or OpenAPI spec. Programmatic surface = (a) per-table inbound webhook URLs (secret URL + optional header auth token = 'custom'), (b) Enterprise-only lookup API using a clay-api-key ('api_key'), (c) official MCP over OAuth. The MCP path is real and self-serve for agents, but general table CRUD / workflow control via a public API does not exist, hence partially_buildable. Plan-gating details for the HTTP API tier come from a third-party comparison page (pipeline.zoominfo.com) corroborated by Clay's own blog/docs; exact plan boundaries may drift.

evidence.note: Official docs: MCP endpoint https://api.clay.com/v3/mcp, OAuth issuer api.clay.com, open Dynamic Client Registration - 'Registration is open - there is no Clay-side approval step.'
Every table can receive JSON via a unique webhook URL with optional one-time-shown authentication token; 50,000 submission limit per webhook (unlimited via Enterprise auto-delete).
HTTP API is an in-UI enrichment column for calling external APIs from Clay tables - not a public API into Clay itself.

Vendor blog: 'MCP with Functions, MCP permissioning, and credit budgets is available now on all modern self-serve (Launch, Growth) and Enterprise plans... lookups are still available for free and trial users.'
Third-party analysis (lead, not proof): no versioned REST API/OpenAPI; webhooks on free tier, HTTP API on Growth+, Enterprise People & Company API enterprise-only; MCP at clay.com/mcp.
